en-US.ADV_DESC_BLOCK_INPUT_WHEN_OPENED:
Hooks into ADOFAI's input architecture across 4 distinct layers:

1. Async Input: Patches scrPlayer.ValidInputWasTriggered and clears key masks in AsyncInputManager.
2. Legacy Input: Patches RDInputType_Keyboard.CheckKeyState to block editing and mouse input.
3. Input Method: Intercepts OptionsPanelsCLS.CheckInputs to suppress menu input events.
4. Direct Input: Uses Transpiler on level select Update methods to redirect UnityEngine.Input calls to custom wrappers.

Also creates a full-screen Raycast target (EmptyGraphic) behind the UI to block UI-level interactions
en-US.ADV_DESC_HIDE_TITLE:
Controls the unused static flag 'GCS.d_dontShowTitles' in game memory.

ADOFAI's codebase contains logic that reads 'd_dontShowTitles' to hide level titles during gameplay,
but the game never assigns a value to this field anywhere.

This option exposes control over that field directly,
enabling native title hiding without needing additional patches
en-US.ADV_DESC_LINUX_TEXT_INPUT_FIX:
Prevents Linux Unity builds from double-processing input caused
by OS text events and physical key events firing simultaneously.

The Process method tracks frame counts and pending states to
pass only the first arriving event of a pair while dropping duplicates.

It also resolves corrupted Shift and CapsLock inputs
by analyzing key codes and modifier states via bitwise operations to recalculate the exact ASCII characters
en-US.ADV_DESC_SHOW_AUTOPLAY_JUDGMENT:
Patches scrPlayer.Hit method using Transpiler.

Original scrPlayer.Hit checks 'this.auto' field
to force hit error meter values to 0.0f (Perfect)
during AutoPlay.
The Transpiler scans IL instructions for Ldarg_0
followed by Ldfld 'auto' or Call 'get_auto',
and replaces them with Ldc_I4_0 and Nop.

This forces the auto check to evaluate as false,
allowing the Error Meter to process actual angle diffs
and margin scales
en-US.DESC_BLOCK_INPUT_WHEN_OPENED: Blocks game inputs while the Overlayer UI is opened
en-US.DESC_HIDE_TITLE: Hides in-game level titles using GCS setting
en-US.DESC_LINUX_TEXT_INPUT_FIX: Fixes duplicate characters and Shift-modified text input on Linux
en-US.DESC_SHOW_AUTOPLAY_JUDGMENT: Applies a patch to show the true judgment in AutoPlay on the Hit Error Meter
